Industries We Serve

Wherever Australasians drill, Blick is there.

Horizontal Directional Drilling

High-performance bentonite and polymer systems for HDD bores from small residential to large diameter crossings.

Waterwell Drilling

Fluid systems designed for waterwell applications — gravel-pack compatible, potable water safe where required.

Geotechnical & Environmental

Products compatible with environmental requirements and soil investigation work — including low-impact and biodegradable options.

Piling & Construction

Speciality fluids and additives for large-diameter piling, auger boring, and construction drilling applications.

Oilfield & Geothermal

Technical fluids, additives, and specialist support for oilfield and geothermal drilling operations across the Pacific region.

Technical Support

We don't just sell product — we support the job.

01 — Tender

Tender & Specification Support

We help you write technical specifications and fluid programs for tender submissions — fast, accurate, and based on the actual bore conditions.

02 — Planning

Fluid Program Planning

Detailed fluid programs for your specific bore: ground conditions, diameter, depth, soil reactivity — calculated before you mobilise.

03 — Execution

On-Site Support

Our technical team can attend the job. If something changes mid-bore, we're on the phone or on site to help you adapt.

04 — Review

Post-Job Technical Review

Debrief on what worked, what didn't, and how to improve performance on the next bore. Building long-term capability with your team.

From the Field

800m HDD crossing, Auckland — reactive clay, solved.

A challenging river crossing in volcanic Auckland geology. High reactive clay content was causing bit balling and stuck pipe. Blick's Clay Control + Carry Flow program kept the bore on schedule and delivered ahead of timeline.

What fluid for reactive clay in a 200mm HDD bore, 120m long, near a waterway?
B
For reactive clay near a waterway, I'd recommend a Carry Flow base with Clay Control additive. The Clay Control encapsulates clay particles and prevents swelling. Here's your program:
PrimaryCarry Flow
35 kg/1000L · builds stable viscosity in reactive clays
AdditiveClay Control
1–2 L/1000L · prevents clay hydration near watercourses
